title: Alliance Rifts Appear
next_chapter_hook: While investigating the traitor, Chen Ji discovered a shocking clue—the person secretly colluding with the Holy Sect was intricately connected to the humiliation of that broken betrothal years ago.

text.content: The crimson order talisman's light exploded within the Tianji Record, and Chen Ji felt a violent vertigo—the gaze of the Heavenly Eye, pressing down on his consciousness like something tangible. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently, his words urgent: "It has come, faster than I anticipated. Boy, this is no time to hide your talents. You must—" "I understand." Chen Ji cut him off, his voice low and calm, as if discussing today's weather. Only he knew that his fingertips had already pierced his palms, blood dripping onto the inner side of his sleeve. He raised his head toward the window—the sky outside was darkening, and above the Council Peak of the Tianqing Sect, storm clouds were slowly gathering.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng) What do you intend to do? Confront them directly? Or—

text.content: Inside the Tianqing Sect Council Hall, the atmosphere was suffocatingly oppressive. Dozens of elders sat on both sides, some with worried expressions, others with flickering gazes, and more already exchanging meaningful glances in secret. Chen Ji stood at the end of the line, eyes downcast and compliant, the perfect picture of a worthless disciple. But his peripheral vision had already caught at least seven hostile gazes—three of which came from elders who had always been closely aligned with the Holy Sect. "Does a废物 have the right to attend?" A sharp voice rang out. Han Lie strode into the hall, followed by five or six elders, his gaze toward Chen Ji like looking at a lamb waiting to be slaughtered.

dialogue.content: (Han Lie, cold smile) Gentlemen, the Heavenly Eye has already taken notice here. The Holy Sect's wrath is about to descend. I believe we should first make our position clear—hand over that废物 and exchange him for the sect's peace!

text.content: The moment he spoke, whispers erupted throughout the hall. Those few elders close to the Holy Sect flashed triumphant glances, and one immediately chimed in: "Elder Han speaks wisely! Chen Ji is nothing but a menial废物, yet he has provoked something as terrifying as the Heavenly Eye. What use is keeping him?" Someone else added with veiled malice: "Back when he somehow survived falling into Soul-Drowning Abyss, it was already suspicious enough. Perhaps he's been a Holy Sect person all along." Chen Ji still kept his head bowed, but the corners of his mouth lifted for an instant—no one noticed the icy amusement in the depths of his pupils beneath his lowered lids. Good. One by one, he，记下了.

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan, speaking slowly, his tone seemingly impartial) Gentlemen, this matter requires further deliberation. After all, Chen Ji is also a disciple of our Tianqing Sect…

text.content: "Further deliberation?" Han Lie cut off Ling Yuan, his voice rising even louder, "Ling Sect Master, the Heavenly Eye won't give us time for deliberation! If the Holy Sect's envoys arrive tomorrow, what do we have to resist them?" He surveyed the surroundings, "Gentlemen, my Xuanwu Sect has decided to withdraw from this so-called alliance. If Tianqing Sect insists on sheltering this废物, then face the consequences yourselves!" Chen Ji sneered in his heart—what a magnificent performance. Unfortunately, he'd seen through it all long ago.

choice.prompt: Han Lie and the pro-Holy Sect faction join forces to strike. How will Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Continue playing the废物, let them revel in their arrogance while secretly gathering evidence, waiting for the perfect moment to eliminate them all.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily lose dignity, being humiliated by everyone
choices.visible_reward: Identify all enemy faces and grasp evidence of the traitors
choices.risk_hint: If the disguise is exposed, all retreat will be lost

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, his face showing a trace of panic, his voice trembling: "Elder Han speaks correctly… I-I don't want to bring disaster to the sect…" He even squeezed out a few tears. Amid the mocking laughter filling the hall, no one noticed the icy smile lurking in the depths of his pupils beneath his lowered lids—good, one by one, all记下了.

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan glances meaningfully at Chen Ji) Since Chen Ji himself is willing to cooperate, let us first detain him, and pass judgment when the Holy Sect envoys arrive.

choices.description: No longer hide, expose Han Lie and the pro-Holy Sect faction's conspiracy on the spot,震慑全场 with thunderous force.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing part of one's strength may attract more attention
choices.visible_reward: Instantly reverse the situation, intimidate the petty, showcase true strength
choices.risk_hint: Exposing oneself prematurely will draw even greater attention from the Heavenly Eye

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed—that smile was gentle enough to send chills down one's spine. "Elder Han, you say I collude with the Holy Sect?" He drew a token from his sleeve—a Holy Sect internal信物, with Han Lie's name engraved on it, "Then how do you explain this?" The entire hall fell deathly silent. Han Lie's face drained of color.

dialogue.content: (Han Lie, terrified) T-This is forged! How could you possibly—

choices.description: Don't confront directly, instead use rhetoric to split the pro-Holy Sect faction, making them suspicious of each other.
choices.visible_reward: Collapse the enemy alliance from within, weaken their forces
choices.risk_hint: If among them are high-level experts, they may see through the rhetoric

text.content: Chen Ji didn't refute Han Lie. Instead, he turned his gaze to those pro-Holy Sect elders, his voice "sincere": "Distinguished elders, I have something I don't understand. When the Holy Sect envoys came, why did they hold secret meetings only with you几位? Though I'm a fool, I'd still like to know—what exactly did you promise the Holy Sect?" Before he even finished speaking, those elders had begun eyeing each other with mutual wariness.

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan, clearing his throat lightly) Chen Ji, do not speak baselessly! This matter… shall be discussed separately.

text.content: Just then, a commotion suddenly arose outside the hall. A disciple tumbled in, his face ghastly pale: "It's terrible! The Holy Sect envoys—the Holy Sect envoys have already arrived at the sect gate! They've brought a black mass of cultivators, and they say they will—will bloodwash the Tianqing Sect!" The hall erupted in chaos. A flash of triumph flickered in Han Lie's eyes, while those pro-Holy Sect elders showed genuine fear—apparently, even they hadn't expected the envoys to arrive so soon.

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan, rising abruptly, his tone stern) Everyone, follow me to the sect gate! Chen Ji… stay at the very back. If the situation turns dire, make your own escape.

text.content: Chen Ji walked behind the group with his head bowed, but his mind was racing with calculations. Ling Yuan's words seemed kind on the surface, but hid a deadly intent—keeping him at the back was precisely convenient for "handling" him. And all those details he'd observed—the silent glances exchanged between the pro-Holy Sect elders and Han Lie, Ling Yuan's subtle hints—everything pointed to one terrifying truth: the traitor within the alliance might not be Han Lie alone.

choice.prompt: On the way to the sect gate, Chen Ji decides to—

choices.description: Seize the chaos to search for evidence of the traitor, possibly uncovering key clues.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial evidence of the traitor's identity
choices.risk_hint: If caught acting suspiciously, will arouse suspicion

text.content: Chen Ji deliberately fell back a few steps, stopping at a corner. His spiritual sense caught two familiar auras conversing in secret—those two pro-Holy Sect elders. "…The Sect Master said, as long as Chen Ji dies, we'll be safe." Chen Ji's pupils contracted: Ling Yuan! As expected!

choices.description: Unite with the only person who might be trusted, to jointly face the approaching crisis.
choices.visible_cost: May expose the special relationship with Su Qingyao
choices.visible_reward: Obtain powerful support, establish a strategic alliance
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may demand answers about his secrets

text.content: Chen Ji stopped Su Qingyao, who was hurrying toward the sect gate, and lowered his voice: "Senior Sister Su, I have something important to tell you." Su Qingyao stared at him coldly: "What trick are you planning this time?" Chen Ji met her eyes directly: "Sect Master Ling… has a problem." Su Qingyao's pupils narrowed, but she didn't immediately refute—the废物's gaze today seemed different.

choices.description: Employ the Demonic Path Saintess's special abilities, preparing for the worst-case scenario.
choices.visible_cost: May expose the connection with the Demonic Path
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Demonic Path's mist for cover, enabling escape at a critical moment
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's conditions may be very harsh

text.content: Chen Ji quietly crushed a communication jade slip. A moment later, a cold voice rang in his mind: "Chen Ji? Contacting me at a time like this… things must be very bad." Chen Ji said grimly: "I need your Demonic Path mist." Ye Qing was silent for a moment: "…Conditions can be discussed later. I'll be waiting outside the sect gate to assist you."

Outside the sect gate, the Holy Sect envoys stood with heads held high, behind them a black mass of cultivators—at a rough count, at least three thousand. The lead envoy looked at the welcoming party from Tianqing Sect, a playful smile on his lips: "The Tianqing Sect people are indeed well-assembled. However… the person I'm looking for doesn't seem to be among those in front?" His gaze越过人群, fixing directly on Chen Ji at the very back. "Chen Ji, the Heavenly Eye has a message for you—it says, you should die."

dialogue.content: (Han Lie, immediately stepping forward) Envoy sir! Chen Ji is right here! Kill him if you wish, it has nothing to do with the Xuanwu Sect!

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at Han Lie's面目 and sneered in his heart—so this is the so-called number one genius of Xuanwu Sect? Hmph, even playing lapdog he plays so eagerly. He slowly stepped forward from the crowd, a faint smile on his face: "Does Envoy sir travel such a great distance just to kill a mere menial disciple?" His tone was eerily calm. "But there is something I don't understand—why is the Heavenly Eye so desperate to see me dead? Could it be… it fears what I might see?"

choice.prompt: Facing the Holy Sect envoys and the threat of Heavenly Dao, Chen Ji chooses—

choices.description: Fight to the death, even if killed, take a few enemies down as垫背.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes a massive amount of Heavenly Fate, may suffer serious injury
choices.visible_reward: Display true strength in the desperate moment, shocking everyone
choices.risk_hint: The enemy is numerous and powerful, with extremely low odds of victory

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly moved. His movement was impossibly swift, and in a flash he had already darted to Han Lie's front, one palm striking Han Lie's chest. Han Lie didn't even have time to react before he was sent flying like a broken kite, blood spurting. "Elder Han," Chen Ji's voice was ice-cold, "you called me废物, didn't you? Let's try that again."

choices.description: Publicly expose that Ling Yuan is the true mastermind,借刀杀人.
choices.visible_cost: Ling Yuan may become desperate and act rashly
choices.visible_reward: Instantly reverse the situation, letting enemies destroy each other
choices.risk_hint: Requires sufficient evidence, otherwise may be counterattacked

text.content: Chen Ji turned, facing the Holy Sect envoy, and smiled faintly: "Envoy sir, are you certain the person you want to kill is me? From what I know, the one the Heavenly Eye truly wishes to eliminate is our Tianqing Sect's Sect Master Ling—the one who was the runner-up for the previous generation's Tianji Record inheritance." Ling Yuan's face contorted: "You're lying!" Chen Ji produced from his chest the token engraved with Ling Yuan's name: "Then how does Sect Master explain this?"

choices.text: Lure the Snake Out of Its Hole
choices.description: Deliberately feign weakness, tempt all enemies to strike together, then counter-kill in one decisive blow.
choices.visible_reward: Identify all enemy faces and eliminate them all in one sweep
choices.risk_hint: If opponents are too powerful, the trick may backfire

text.content: Chen Ji "panicked" as he stumbled backward and fell to the ground. The Holy Sect envoy sneered: "Is that all?" He casually waved his hand. "Go, kill him." Three or four Holy Sect disciples rushed forward. The instant they neared Chen Ji, a black mist suddenly enveloped the entire area—Ye Qing's voice sounded in Chen Ji's ear: "Now, you can proceed." Chen Ji rose slowly, the panic vanishing from his face, replaced by bone-deep chill.

At this critical moment, the sky suddenly darkened. A massive eye phantom slowly opened within the clouds—that was the true projection of the Heavenly Eye! Its gaze swept across everyone present, finally fixing on Chen Ji. An ancient and authoritative voice resounded in everyone's mind: "The Tianji Record… has finally appeared." Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record Fragment within him vibrating violently, seemingly resonating across the void with that Eye. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out urgently: "Bad! It's not here to kill you—it's here to reclaim the Tianji Record!"

The Holy Sect envoy's expression also changed—clearly, this was not part of their plan. The Heavenly Eye's projection ignored everyone. In that massive eye, a hint of greed flickered: "Hand it over." Chen Ji stood his ground, his expression unchanged. Countless thoughts raced through his mind: if the Tianji Record is reclaimed, everything ends; but if he continues to hold it, the Heavenly Eye's pursuit will only grow more frantic. At that moment, he suddenly sensed a faint yet familiar aura—his sister Chen Nian's aura!

Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, his gaze piercing through the Heavenly Eye's projection into the distant void. Chen Nian—she must be there! His fists clenched tight, fingernails digging deep into his palms. In that instant, he made his decision: whatever the cost, he would rescue his sister. The Heavenly Eye seemed to sense something. That massive eye narrowed slightly: "Interesting… you're actually searching for her? That Heavenly Fate Lock Key… so you too have a weakness." Chen Ji's gaze turned ice-cold—this was his greatest taboo, and no one was permitted to touch it.

Absolute silence filled the scene. Ling Yuan, Han Lie, the Holy Sect envoy—everyone waited for Chen Ji's choice. And Chen Ji simply raised his head slowly, looking at that lofty Heavenly Eye, the corner of his mouth curving into a faint arc. "Weakness?" His voice was calm and clear, "You're wrong. I have no weakness—only things I must do regardless." Before the words even finished, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly blazed with dazzling light, a profound rune forming in the air. For the first time, the Heavenly Eye's projection showed a tremor: "You dare—!"

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng, shocked and furious) Boy! You're insane! Using the complete foresight will drain all your Heavenly Fate! You will die!

text.content: Chen Ji didn't answer Mo Xiansheng. His gaze pierced through the Heavenly Eye's projection, looking into the even farther void—where a blurry figure was watching him. Chen Nian… he saw his sister imprisoned in a dark space, surrounded by诡异的符文. Her eyes were tightly closed, her lips trembling faintly, as if whispering something. Chen Ji's eyes widened sharply—two characters, crystal clear: Brother, run!

Chen Ji's eye sockets faintly reddened, but his voice was ice-cold iron. "Run?" he said softly, "I have waited for this day far too long." He raised his head,直视 the Heavenly Eye's projection, "You want to reclaim the Tianji Record? Fine. But not now—I will bring her back first." His fingers traced a trajectory through the air. The Tianji Record's runes spun madly, an unprecedented formation taking shape. Ling Yuan, Han Lie, the Holy Sect envoy—everyone felt a terror rising from the depths of their souls. This废物… what exactly is he planning to do?
